items.title: Why Are Lattice Semiconductor (LSCC) Shares Soaring Today
items.summary: Shares of semiconductor designer Lattice Semiconductor (NASDAQ:LSCC) jumped 5.7% in the afternoon session after the company launched its Mach-N2 FPGA line and Prompt AI development tool for data center security and efficiency, alongside a newly disclosed $94.74 million stake by Bank of America.

items.title: Bank of America hikes S&P 500 target after Al trade cracks
items.summary: The bank raised its 2026 year-end target to 7,400 and set a 12-month goal of 7,800, closing out a losing bet against Alphabet and Meta in the process.

items.title: Investors Expect AI Growth to Continue, BofA Survey Shows
items.summary: Nearly 35% of investors who responded to Bank of America's September credit investor survey expect little meaningful regulation in the artificial intelligence industry in the near term. Another 22% of respondents said regulation could have an insignificant impact on AI capital expenditure.
